name: local-ai-flow-ui
description: Settings + HUD webviews for Local AI Flow. Plain TypeScript, no framework, no runtime deps; talks to the Rust core via the Tauri global (`withGlobalTauri`).

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.ts src/hud.ts --outdir=dist --format=iife --target=safari15 && cp -f src/../dist/styles.css dist/styles.css || true
